# clo_account_limits (Resource)

Manage the specified project limits. Removing a limit or destroying this resource leaves its last value in CLO. Manage each project and limit pair in one resource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `addresses` (Map of Number) Map of project IDs to maximum values for addresses.
- `dbaas_clusters` (Map of Number) Map of project IDs to maximum values for dbaas clusters.
- `disk_space` (Map of Number) Map of project IDs to maximum values for disk space.
- `loadbalancer` (Map of Number) Map of project IDs to maximum values for loadbalancer.
- `s3_max_space` (Map of Number) Map of project IDs to maximum values for s3 max space.
- `servers` (Map of Number) Map of project IDs to maximum values for servers.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `default` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Imports enabled writable limits for all projects. Declare only the pairs this resource should continue managing.
terraform import clo_account_limits.example account
```
